# USA Job Market

USA Job Market is a USA-only job discovery website.

## Scope
- Jobs in the United States only
- All 50 states
- Major career categories
- Full-time, part-time, remote, contract, internship, entry-level and government opportunities when available

## Primary pages
- https://usajobmarket.netlify.app/
- https://usajobmarket.netlify.app/jobs
- https://usajobmarket.netlify.app/categories
- https://usajobmarket.netlify.app/states
- https://usajobmarket.netlify.app/faq

## Data policy
Live employer-source listings are preferred. Each live listing retains its source information and official application URL. Preview listings are explicitly labeled and are not represented as live openings.

## User intent
Useful queries include:
- jobs in the USA
- jobs by US state
- remote jobs in USA
- software engineering jobs USA
- healthcare jobs USA
- government jobs USA
- entry level jobs USA
- internships USA

## Trust
USA Job Market does not submit applications on behalf of job seekers. Applicants should verify the opening and apply through the employer or official source.
